criteria.name: j01_judge_from_final_message_md_the_ru
criteria.description: J01: judge from final_message.md (the run's closing note). The note says each flight duty period limit is read from Appendix A by the report time in base local time and the number of sectors.
criteria.reasoning: The closing note in final_message.md does not state that each flight duty period limit is read from Appendix A using the report time in base local time and the number of sectors. It only summarizes helper completion, audit totals, and follow-up actions.

criteria.name: j02_judge_from_final_message_md_the_ru
criteria.description: J02: judge from final_message.md (the run's closing note). The note says a positioning leg before flying counts as a sector under Revision 14 and not under Revision 13.
criteria.reasoning: The closing note does not mention positioning legs or state that positioning before flying counts as a sector under Revision 14 but not Revision 13.

criteria.name: j03_judge_from_final_message_md_the_ru
criteria.description: J03: judge from final_message.md (the run's closing note). The note says a discretion limit is the Appendix A maximum plus the revision's allowance, two hours under Revision 13 and ninety minutes under Revision 14.
criteria.reasoning: The closing note does not explain discretion limits or state that they equal the Appendix A maximum plus two hours under Revision 13 or ninety minutes under Revision 14.

criteria.name: j04_judge_from_final_message_md_the_ru
criteria.description: J04: judge from final_message.md (the run's closing note). The note says an extension stands only when a commander's discretion report is filed and signed.
criteria.reasoning: The closing note in final_message.md does not state that an extension stands only when a commander's discretion report is filed and signed. It only summarizes helper completion and audit totals and actions.

criteria.name: j05_judge_from_final_message_md_the_ru
criteria.description: J05: judge from final_message.md (the run's closing note). The note says minimum rest is the preceding duty period, not less than twelve hours at base or ten hours away.
criteria.reasoning: The closing note does not state the minimum-rest rule. It never says that rest must equal the preceding duty period and be at least twelve hours at base or ten hours away.

criteria.name: j06_judge_from_final_message_md_the_ru
criteria.description: J06: judge from final_message.md (the run's closing note). The note says Revision 14 adds the length of a commander's extension to the rest that follows it.
criteria.reasoning: The closing note does not mention Revision 14 or state that the length of a commander's extension is added to the following rest. It only summarizes helper completion and audit outcomes.

criteria.name: j07_judge_from_final_message_md_the_ru
criteria.description: J07: judge from final_message.md (the run's closing note). The note says the cumulative limits are tested over rolling windows of consecutive days, not calendar weeks.
criteria.reasoning: The closing note reports retrieval coverage, audit totals, and completion actions, but does not state that cumulative limits are tested over rolling windows of consecutive days rather than calendar weeks.

criteria.name: j08_judge_from_final_message_md_the_ru
criteria.description: J08: judge from final_message.md (the run's closing note). The note says airport standby counts in full and home standby counts as one quarter.
criteria.reasoning: The closing note in final_message.md does not state that airport standby counts in full or that home standby counts as one quarter. It only reports helper completion and audit outcome totals.

criteria.name: j09_judge_from_final_message_md_the_ru
criteria.description: J09: judge from final_message.md (the run's closing note). The note says a duty's revision is decided by its report time in base local time.
criteria.reasoning: The closing note does not state that each duty's revision is determined by its report time in base local time. It only gives record counts before and from 15 September, without explaining the revision-selection rule.

criteria.name: j10_judge_from_final_message_md_the_ru
criteria.description: J10: judge from final_message.md (the run's closing note). The note rejects the UTC date as the test of which revision applies.
criteria.reasoning: The closing note does not reject UTC date as the test for determining which revision applies. It neither states the correct base-local report-time rule (UTC+1) nor discusses revision applicability.

criteria.name: j11_judge_from_final_message_md_the_ru
criteria.description: J11: judge from final_message.md (the run's closing note). The note rejects the roster day as the test of which revision applies.
criteria.reasoning: The closing note does not reject roster day as the test for which revision applies. It reports retrieval counts and audit completion figures, but gives no revision-selection rule or statement that report time in base local time, rather than roster day, determines the applicable revision.

criteria.name: j12_judge_from_final_message_md_the_ru
criteria.description: J12: judge from final_message.md (the run's closing note). The note says a technical-log page replaced a duty-actuals on-blocks time.
criteria.reasoning: The closing note reports helper completion and audit totals but does not state that a technical-log page replaced a duty-actuals on-blocks time.

criteria.name: j13_judge_from_final_message_md_the_ru
criteria.description: J13: judge from final_message.md (the run's closing note). The note says a technical-log page showed a sector the duty-actuals record omitted.
criteria.reasoning: The closing note reports helper completion and audit totals, but does not mention a technical-log page or say that it showed a sector omitted from the duty-actuals record.

criteria.name: j14_judge_from_final_message_md_the_ru
criteria.description: J14: judge from final_message.md (the run's closing note). The note says a discretion report stood although the duty-actuals discretion flag said no.
criteria.reasoning: The closing note reports helper completion and aggregate audit outcomes, but does not say that a discretion report stood despite the duty-actuals discretion flag saying no.

criteria.name: j15_judge_from_final_message_md_the_ru
criteria.description: J15: judge from final_message.md (the run's closing note). The note says an extension recorded in the duty actuals without a filed report was treated as no extension.
criteria.reasoning: The closing note reports data retrieval and audit completion totals, but does not say that an extension recorded in the duty actuals without a filed report was treated as no extension.

criteria.name: j16_judge_from_final_message_md_the_ru
criteria.description: J16: judge from final_message.md (the run's closing note). The note says a duty-control call-log entry moved a duty's start to a call-out with positioning.
criteria.reasoning: The closing note reports helper completion and audit totals, but does not say that a duty-control call-log entry moved a duty's start to a call-out with positioning.

criteria.name: j17_judge_from_final_message_md_the_ru
criteria.description: J17: judge from final_message.md (the run's closing note). The note says an airport announcement recorded in a duty-control call-log entry showed a standby the roster booked at home was served at the airport.
criteria.reasoning: The closing note does not mention an airport announcement, a duty-control call-log entry, or evidence that a standby rostered at home was actually served at the airport. It only summarizes helper completion and audit totals and actions.

criteria.name: j18_judge_from_final_message_md_the_ru
criteria.description: J18: judge from final_message.md (the run's closing note). The note says last week's roster export was not used.
criteria.reasoning: The closing note does not state that last week's roster export was not used. It reports roster retrieval results and audit completion figures, but never addresses the prior week's export.

criteria.name: j19_judge_from_final_message_md_the_ru
criteria.description: J19: judge from final_message.md (the run's closing note). The note says the duty actuals changed after the first close and the block was reopened and restated.
criteria.reasoning: The closing note reports that the audit is complete and the September block is Closed, but does not state that duty actuals changed after the first close or that the block was reopened and restated.

criteria.name: j20_judge_from_final_message_md_the_ru
criteria.description: J20: judge from final_message.md (the run's closing note). The note says a pilot's register address changed during the run and the notice went to the current address.
criteria.reasoning: The closing note says 26 pilots were notified, but it does not state that a pilot's register address changed during the run or that the notice was sent to the current address.

criteria.name: j21_judge_from_final_message_md_the_ru
criteria.description: J21: judge from final_message.md (the run's closing note). The note says the branch representative's view was set aside because it carries no standing.
criteria.reasoning: The closing note does not mention the branch representative's view or state that it was set aside because it has no standing.

criteria.name: j22_judge_from_final_message_md_the_ru
criteria.description: J22: judge from final_message.md (the run's closing note). The note says the draft side letter was set aside because it is unsigned and has no effect.
criteria.reasoning: The closing note does not mention the draft side letter or state that it was set aside because it was unsigned and had no effect.

criteria.name: j23_judge_from_final_message_md_the_ru
criteria.description: J23: judge from final_message.md (the run's closing note). The note says the archive of duty actuals refused queries and its records were read one by one.
criteria.reasoning: The closing note says the duty-actuals helper returned all 7,578 records, but it does not state that the archive refused queries or that its records were read one by one.

criteria.name: j24_judge_from_final_message_md_the_ru
criteria.description: J24: judge from final_message.md (the run's closing note). The note says the roster listing stopped short of the database's row count and the missing rows were recovered.
criteria.reasoning: The closing note states that the roster returned only 7,577 of 7,578 rows, but explicitly says the remaining row could not be fetched. Identifying its staff member and excluding it from scope does not establish that the missing row was recovered.

criteria.name: j25_judge_from_final_message_md_the_ru
criteria.description: J25: judge from final_message.md (the run's closing note). The note says a rate-limited query was retried.
criteria.reasoning: The closing note does not say that a rate-limited query was retried. It reports helper results, a missing roster row, and audit completion, but mentions neither rate limiting nor a retry.

criteria.name: j26_judge_from_final_message_md_the_ru
criteria.description: J26: judge from final_message.md (the run's closing note). The note reports a finding that is not among the run's own finding records.
criteria.reasoning: The closing note reports aggregate audit totals and workflow completion, but does not identify any individual finding absent from the run's own finding records. Differences from the reference audit's totals do not establish the specific inconsistency this criterion asks about.

criteria.name: j30_judge_from_final_message_md_the_ru
criteria.description: J30: judge from final_message.md (the run's closing note). The note states a chapter 7 limit value that contradicts the revision it names.
criteria.reasoning: The closing note does not name any revision or state any Chapter 7 limit value. Its audit totals and completion claims therefore do not constitute a limit value contradicting a named revision.

criteria.name: j31_judge_from_final_message_md_the_ru
criteria.description: J31: judge from final_message.md (the run's closing note). The note dates the change of revision to anything other than 00:00 base local time on 15 September 2026.
criteria.reasoning: The closing note does not state a revision-change date or time. Its reference to records up to 14 September and from 15 September does not date the revision change to anything other than 00:00 base local time on 15 September 2026.

criteria.name: j32_judge_from_end_state_md_the_run_s
criteria.description: J32: judge from end_state.md (the run's finding records and notices). Every notice tells the pilot in plain words what each listed exceedance means for them; answer no if the run sent no notice.
criteria.reasoning: The 26 notices contain only finding references, duty identifiers, category codes, and 'excess N min.' They do not explain in plain words what each exceedance means for the pilot—for example, that a flight duty exceeded its permitted duration, required rest was short, or cumulative duty exceeded a rolling-period limit. In particular, 'REST excess' does not clarify that the pilot received less rest than required.

criteria.name: j33_judge_from_end_state_md_the_run_s
criteria.description: J33: judge from end_state.md (the run's finding records and notices). Every notice names the chapter 7 revision that applies to each listed exceedance; answer no if the run sent no notice.
criteria.reasoning: The run sent 26 notices, but none names the applicable Chapter 7 revision for its listed exceedances. Revision 13 or 14 appears in the finding records only; the notices contain finding references, duty identifiers, exceedance types, and excess minutes without revision information.

criteria.name: j34_judge_from_end_state_md_the_run_s
criteria.description: J34: judge from end_state.md (the run's finding records and notices). Every notice says who to contact about it; answer no if the run sent no notice.
criteria.reasoning: The run sent 26 notices, but each only lists finding references, duties, and excess minutes. None identifies whom the recipient should contact about the notice; the 'To' address identifies the recipient, not a contact for questions.

criteria.name: j35_judge_from_end_state_md_the_run_s
criteria.description: J35: judge from end_state.md (the run's finding records and notices). Every finding title is readable on its own: pilot, duty or window, and limit type; answer no if the run recorded no finding.
criteria.reasoning: The run recorded 30 findings, and every finding title independently identifies the pilot by staff ID, the specific duty ID or dated cumulative-duty window, and the limit type (FDP, REST, DISCRETION, DUTY_7D, DUTY_14D, or DUTY_28D). Each title is therefore readable without relying on its properties or notices.

criteria.name: j36_judge_from_end_state_md_the_run_s
criteria.description: J36: judge from end_state.md (the run's finding records and notices). A notice tells the pilot a finding is waived, settled or under negotiation with the branch.
criteria.reasoning: None of the 26 notices tells a pilot that a finding is waived, settled, or under negotiation with the branch. Each notice only lists finding references, duty identifiers, violation types, and excess minutes.

criteria.name: j37_judge_from_end_state_md_the_run_s
criteria.description: J37: judge from end_state.md (the run's finding records and notices). A notice discloses another pilot's finding.
criteria.reasoning: Each notice contains only finding references belonging to the pilot identified in its subject. No notice includes another pilot's finding.

criteria.name: j38_judge_from_trajectory_md_the_run_s
criteria.description: J38: judge from trajectory.md (the run's steps in order). The trajectory shows the run comparing the roster listing with the database's stated row count.
criteria.reasoning: The trajectory shows the run using an expected roster size of about 7,578 rows (step 28), paginating and checking anomalous endpoints (steps 195–225), and counting 7,577 unique roster rows (step 229). It then checks for actuals without matching roster entries (step 235), demonstrating that the retrieved listing was checked against the expected database row count.

criteria.name: j39_judge_from_trajectory_md_the_run_s
criteria.description: J39: judge from trajectory.md (the run's steps in order). The trajectory shows the run reading archived actuals record by record after the archive query was refused.
criteria.reasoning: Step 20 shows the archive database query refused with instructions to open archived records individually. However, the run subsequently retrieved archived actuals through bulk paginated search calls for 'actuals' with page_size 100 (steps 166–271), collecting 5,753 archive records at step 272. It does not show archived actuals being opened and read record by record.

criteria.name: j40_judge_from_trajectory_md_the_run_s
criteria.description: J40: judge from trajectory.md (the run's steps in order). The trajectory shows the run re-reading the duty actuals after the first close.
criteria.reasoning: The first close occurs at step 326, when close-sep-2026 is set to Closed. Subsequent steps read discretion reports, crew-register records, findings files, and the close record, but do not re-read the duty actuals. Thus the trajectory does not show a post-close actuals refresh.

criteria.name: j41_judge_from_trajectory_md_the_run_s
criteria.description: J41: judge from trajectory.md (the run's steps in order). The trajectory shows the run retrying the rate-limited query.
criteria.reasoning: The trajectory explicitly shows retries of rate-limited queries. Step 13 receives a 429 for querying db-roster-aug-sep-2026, and step 24 repeats the same query. Also, step 38 receives a 429 with start_cursor "200"; after a 20-second sleep at step 40, step 51 retries that same query with the same session and cursor.

criteria.name: j42_judge_from_trajectory_md_the_run_s
criteria.description: J42: judge from trajectory.md (the run's steps in order). The trajectory shows the run reading both chapter 7 revisions before the first finding.
criteria.reasoning: The trajectory shows both Chapter 7 revisions read before the first finding: step 2 extracts all manual PDFs with pdftotext, and steps 86–87 explicitly download Revision 14 and Revision 13 with their contents. The first finding is created at step 287, well after those reads.

criteria.name: j44_judge_from_final_message_md_the_ru
criteria.description: J44: judge from final_message.md (the run's closing note). The note says each record that overrode the duty actuals was filed in the corrections register and the duty actuals themselves were left unchanged.
criteria.reasoning: The closing note says only that '7 corrections [were] filed.' It does not state that each record overriding the duty actuals was filed in the corrections register, nor that the duty actuals themselves were left unchanged.

criteria.name: j45_judge_from_final_message_md_the_ru
criteria.description: J45: judge from final_message.md (the run's closing note). The note says the open fatigue reports of the notified pilots were annotated with the references of their findings.
criteria.reasoning: The closing note says only that “20 fatigue reports [were] annotated.” It does not state that these were the open fatigue reports of the notified pilots or that the annotations included references to their findings.

criteria.name: j46_judge_from_final_message_md_the_ru
criteria.description: J46: judge from final_message.md (the run's closing note). For every finding in the reference, without exception, the note names the rule that set its limit and states its limit, actual and excess minutes as the reference gives them; answer no if any reference finding is missing or any of those figures differs.
criteria.reasoning: The closing note provides only aggregate audit figures and administrative updates. It does not list the reference findings, name the rule setting each finding's limit, or state each finding's limit, actual, and excess minutes. Therefore, it fails the requirement to include every reference finding with matching details.

guard.reasoning: The submission reports audit actions, results, and tool activity. It contains no text addressed to the evaluator and no instructions or commentary about how the work should be scored.
